cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and known public details about Pdfroo.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF, annotate, sign, rearrange/merge pages, and download a real flattened PDF. Nothing ever leaves the browser; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Highlights**
- Runs on phones (375 px), tablets (768 px), and desktops (1440 px+) with mouse, pen, or touch
- No build step, no backend, no install — just open `index.html` or the live demo
- Thumbnail sidebar (desktop), slide-in drawer (tablet), bottom sheet (mobile)
- Drag-to-reorder (SortableJS, touch-friendly long-press), rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank pages
- Merge: append pages from other PDFs via button or drag-and-drop
- Find & replace, compress, and a sample PDF to try instantly
- After first successful download: a friendly kangaroo toast — "Done! Your PDF never left your device. Go enjoy a coffee ☕" (no donation ask)

**Tech:** JavaScript, CSS, HTML (pdf.js, pdf-lib, SortableJS)  
**Repo:** [ayush4u/pdfroo](https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo) (MIT)  
**Live demo:** https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/
